videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: The Squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. It's delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the Squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: 'It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my wedding.' King Tiger has met his perfect partner and is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: Duggee and the squirrels are tidying up before 'Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day'. Duggee has his grandparents' badge, so he knows what they will like, a nice cup of tea.

videos.title: Bluey Minisodes
videos.description: At the tattoo shop, Dad wants to get skulls and snakes because he wants to look tough. When it's time to reveal, it's not quite what Dad envisaged, and he tries to hide it from the family.

videos.title: Go Jetters
videos.description: The Grimbots are flying the Vroomster and their dodgy manoeuvres are about to flatten the Parthenon, Go Jetters, Go.

videos.title: Peter Rabbit
videos.description: When the auditions for Mr Jeremy Fisher's annual recital attract the attention of Mr Tod, it's up to Peter to save the day with some musical mischief of his own.

videos.title: Octonauts
videos.description: The Octonauts study a group of baby hammerhead sharks as they hunt on their own for the first time and poke their noses into trouble.

videos.title: Mojo Swoptops
videos.description: It's Christmas Eve! When Santa's magical sleigh crashes and scatters gifts across Mount Swoppiton, Mojo and Bo do a merry top-swop, because ho-ho-helping Santa is what they do!

videos.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
videos.description: Let's get festive with my Unwrap Challenge! What's on your Christmas list? Let's take a peek - Christmas stars, ice skaters and burpees. The big prezzie is the Activate! Get ready to move with Joe and the Activators.

videos.title: Something Special
videos.description: There's a party, and everyone is invited. Justin and his friend arrange a disco party with a difference, while Mr Tumble holds his own disco party at Tumble Cottage.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: It's Christmas and Bluey is focused on being good to get more presents. When a game of Verandah Santa leaves cousin Socks upset, Bluey learns the virtue of kindness.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

videos.title: Peter Rabbit's Christmas Tale
videos.description: When Mr Bouncer gets too sick to make the important holiday supply delivery, Peter and Benjamin take it upon themselves to brave a blizzard to get the job done and meet a new friend along the way.

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: Isn't it time for Jingle Bells? A festive Hey Duggee tune for you and your little Squirrels to sing and dance along to.

videos.title: Octonauts
videos.description: The Vegimals' plans for a Christmas feast aboard the Octopod are interrupted when the Octonauts are all entangled in a gigantic blob of sea snot!

videos.title: Zog
videos.description: Take to the skies with Zog the lovable orange dragon, Doctor Princess Pearl and Sir Gadabout the Great as they soar across the land and care for all their fantastical friends.

videos.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
videos.description: Rafi's guitar wish brings musical mayhem at the school music festival.

videos.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
videos.description: Team Spidey want to give Aunt May a snow day for Christmas, but first they need to help Santa Claus. The Thing and Spidey help Aunt Petunia rescue her stolen latkes on Hanukkah.

videos.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
videos.description: Rising water endangers some albatross nests, so the Octonauts help to relocate them.

videos.title: Knee High Spies
videos.description: The spies are excited to go on a family holiday, but Silver Paw tries to ruin it by turning off Dad's early morning alarm. To save the trip, Jeremy sneaks out of the suitcase for a solo mission.

videos.title: Supertato
videos.description: It's Merry Sprouty Day, and everyone is waiting for Sprouty Claus, who is bringing presents to all the good fruit and veggies. However, Evil Pea has an evil plan to steal the presents for herself.

videos.title: Mr Tumble
videos.description: Join Mr Tumble as he sings and signs We Wish You a Merry Christmas!

videos.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
videos.description: The star has disappeared from the Christmas tree. Does the little elf know where it is?

videos.title: Dodge's Pup School
videos.description: Following Dodge at Pup School, a place full of mishaps and mayhem. Dodge and his pup pals turn school days into adventures with singing, silliness, and occasional squeaky toys.

videos.title: My World Kitchen
videos.description: Lola's family are from Spain, a country in Southern Europe. She is making a traditional Spanish dish called empanadas for her friends, with a fish and vegetable filling and a side of Spanish dancing!

videos.title: I Can Grow It
videos.description: The Buds explore the blooming summer garden and the colourful magic of its flowers.

videos.title: Monster Makes
videos.description: It's the day of the annual Teddy Bear Party. Murphi is making sandwiches, and Rebecca has made jelly. A little mishap inspires Murphi's first monster make - a tiny toadstool pot. The Mini Monsters create paper cup critter puppets, and Rebecca's cousin, Fiona, calls to share her idea for a cupcake case flower. Murphi's mega monster make is a teddy bear box, helped by some round boxes brought along by the Recycling Express.

videos.title: Balamory
videos.description: Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest, but it's trickier than expected.

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: It's nearly Christmas and Duggee is wrapping presents to go under the tree. He asks the squirrels if they want to help decorate the clubhouse for Christmas. Of course, they do.

videos.title: Octonauts
videos.description: The Octonauts must help a giant sunfish who can't swim straight, before it hurts other sea creatures and itself.

videos.title: Vida the Vet
videos.description: It is a snowy day in Sweetwood and Zigzag's day is almost ruined when she refuses to wear mittens and gets way too cold. Luckily, Vida knows how to warm her up and Popcorn knows how to make cocoa, so together they save the snow day.

videos.title: Go Jetters
videos.description: After a rainbow appears over the Go Jet Academy, Glitch becomes fascinated with the legend of a pot of gold appearing at the end of it. He tries to create his own, bigger rainbow, ignoring Ubercorn's warnings that their ends can never be reached. When he instead causes a huge storm to appear, the Go Jetters must work fast to stop the Academy from flooding.

videos.title: Big Lizard
videos.description: During a hoverboard race, Dad's new super-powered hoverboard malfunctions, so Cosima and Big Lizard throw the race to rescue him!

videos.title: Yukee
videos.description: It's been snowing, and Yukee and her garden friends use music and beat to build a big snow band.

videos.title: Froglets
videos.description: The Froglets explore Lilly's desk then set sail on a daring pirate quest for treasure.

videos.title: Something Special
videos.description: It's Christmas Eve and the Tumble Family are desperately trying to get everything ready for Christmas Day. In true Tumble fashion, chaos ensues.

videos.title: What's in Your Plant Pot?
videos.description: Mark demonstrates how sweet, fresh peas grow on leafy green plants.

videos.title: Balamory
videos.description: Dr Ollie has lost his thinking cap and can't think up a new song for the nursery children. He dashes around Balamory searching for his hat but makes a surprising discovery.

videos.title: Zog
videos.description: Spark isn't feeling well, but Madam Dragon insists he is fine - just over-excited about his lesson. Zog's intuition tells him Madam Dragon is wrong, but can he tell her?

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend that they are in control of their every move. Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

videos.description: After finding out Grand-Mae's magical lantern brings shadows to life, Bee accidentally creates a bunch of shadow caterpillars.

videos.description: Duggee's old friend Clarence has lost his Christmas cheer, so the squirrels try to inspire him by showing what they most enjoy about the holiday.

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: It is news time at the Clubhouse, and the squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower, and Roly remembers he is getting a new brother or sister.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurant with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to. He's going to need an app to order the food.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: While Dad and his mates pull out some tree stumps in the garden, Bluey, Bingo and Muffin turn one stump into a nail salon. When it comes time to pull out the girls' stump, Dad must strike a deal.

videos.title: Go Jetters Go!
videos.description: Kym and Xuli search Hawaii for bright colours, but the answer is hiding beneath the waves.

videos.title: Peter Rabbit
videos.description: When Peter and his friends mistake the echoey 'rebbits' of a lost Jeremy Fisher for a scary monster, they set about to rid their tunnels of this mysterious invader. But with Tommy Brock on the warpath nearby, it won't be easy!

videos.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
videos.description: The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea and onto land. With new rides and new friends, they are prepared to protect any habitats and animals at risk on land or underwater.

videos.title: Numberblocks
videos.description: The adventures of ten friends in Numberland who can always count on each other. Each friend has a different ability that helps them on their adventures.

videos.title: Colourblocks
videos.description: Purple introduces an exciting new musical game - Guess the Colour!

videos.title: Love Monster
videos.description: Love Monster, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Bad Idea Puppy arrive at Elder Kitten's house with a cart full of decorating things.

videos.title: Playtime Towers
videos.description: Bella and Lift discover all sorts of leaves in Playtime Towers.

videos.title: Bing
videos.description: Bing and Sula are building a stone tower in the Howly Woods when Sula finds an ammonite. Bing wants to find one too but is overwhelmed by the amount of stones, which makes it very difficult to find one. A frustrated Bing sits down, and Sula notices some ammonites in the rock behind him. Flop takes a picture of Bing and Sula with their ammonites.

videos.title: Yakka Dee
videos.description: Dee encourages a friend to say 'digger' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different diggers, a driving digger, a dumping digger and a dizzy digger. There's a muddy digger, a dozing digger and even a disco digger.

videos.title: Tralala
videos.description: Tralala and friends save the day when Sid gets stuck in a blackberry bush.

videos.title: MaeBee
videos.description: After finding out Grand-Mae's magical lantern brings shadows to life, Bee accidentally creates a bunch of shadow caterpillars.

videos.title: Kiri and Lou
videos.description: Lou's trunk has a mind of its own and goes out sniffing while Lou is asleep.

videos.title: Twirlywoos
videos.description: The Twirlywoos are watching a man fly his model aeroplane. Toodloo jumps into the seat and Great BigHoo uses the control box to fly Toodloo and the aeroplane.

videos.title: Something Special
videos.description: It's Christmas, and the Tumbles are having a fancy dress party. Justin visits a children's hospital where he and his friends enjoy a celebration in their own winter wonderland.

videos.title: Teletubbies
videos.description: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch bunny rabbits. Bunny ears and tails appear on the Teletubbies. They do the 'bunny hop-hop' before saying 'eh oh' to the Tiddlytubbies.

videos.title: The Baby Club
videos.description: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Alara, Samaa, Reece, Eleanor, Ty'lana and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside Giovanna's bag are some scented lavender bags, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that are smelly.

videos.title: I Spy, You Spy
videos.description: Elsie plays I Spy whilst celebrating Christmas with her new friend Seb.

videos.title: Maddie and Triggs
videos.description: While watching TV, Maddie and Triggs keep annoying each other with their noisy snacking! But luckily Dad is on hand to help them remember the things they like about each other.

videos.title: Monster Makes
videos.description: It is picnic day! Rebecca and Murphy craft a 'soup-er' fly in a bowl of soup. Meanwhile, on the Recycling Express, they transform an old storage tub into a terrific drum kit.

videos.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
videos.description: Raa Raa becomes the singer in Crocky's Jingly Jangly Jungle Band, but he gets so carried away with his singing that he forgets a promise.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: Bluey and Bingo get Daddy Robot to clean the playroom when they don't want to do it.

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!

videos.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
videos.description: Jasiri finds out some fascinating frog facts. Rory and his son Sandy hop like frogs to the local loch side and make a pond in their garden. Ferne visits an aquarium to meet some amazing amphibians, including poison dart frogs.

videos.title: My First Festivals
videos.description: Follow Neave and her family as they learn about and celebrate St Andrew's Day. They start off by visiting the statue of St Andrew and talk about how to celebrate the national holiday.

videos.title: Big Cook Little Cook
videos.description: The café is very noisy, because all the cupboards are creaking and Small's scooter is squeaking. Today's recipe is crispy tools for Maisie the Mechanic, who may be able to help with their noisy problems.

videos.title: Dog Squad
videos.description: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli wants to get a present for her friend Jay's new baby, Nancy.

videos.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild
videos.description: Steve and Aneeshwar meet some Asian elephants and give them a shower with a giant hose. They see how the elephants use their trunk in lots of different ways and discover more about these clever animals. Their next animal is the ring-tailed lemur.

videos.title: What's on Your Head?
videos.description: Alexandra shows us her barrister's wig. She explains why she loves her wig so much and what it means to be able to wear it.

videos.title: Waffle's After School Club
videos.description: The After Schoolers play keepy uppy with balloons. Mrs Hobbs is very competitive, but it's Waffle who's the champ, keeping the last balloon up with a perfectly timed bottom bounce.

videos.title: Puffin Rock
videos.description: Oona and Silky are excited about playing in the Kelp Forest, but things take a strange turn when they get there, with all the sea creatures seemingly trying to annoy them.

videos.title: Yukee
videos.description: TapTap's sister, TipTop, comes for a visit and amazes Yukee with her drumming skills. She is deaf, and she drums just as well as TapTap, making Yukee wonder how she does it. With TipTop's help, Yukee learns how to feel the music.

videos.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
videos.description: To fulfil Barnaby's wish of becoming a baby, Lu and Gus play a family game with him.

videos.title: Piggy Builders
videos.description: The Piggies are called to find Fred's lost book, but his bookshelf collapses when they arrive. Charlie and Cornelia repair the shelf, while Cesar searches with neighbours who end up giving them even more books to organise.

videos.title: Numberblocks
videos.description: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.

videos.title: Alphablocks
videos.description: It's snowing! The Alphablocks whip up a wondrous winter wonderland: but can they get Mr Snowman to the North Pole before he melts? This episode has fun with 'an' and the words man, fun, sun, fan, tan, van and men.

videos.title: Something Special
videos.description: Maddie and friends get ready for the day, while sorting out toys makes Mr Tumble sleepy.

videos.title: Teletubbies
videos.description: Laa-Laa and Po play a game of "hide and seek". They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dipsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

videos.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
videos.description: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how lichen plays such an important role in the environment. They find out that lichen loves to grow in places where the air is clean, can be used by birds to build nests and be food for insects and animals too. On the way, they take time to enjoy the beautiful nature they see and find something interesting under a log!

videos.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
videos.description: Maddie finds out about things that go up and down. She shows how a lift works when it carries people up and down between floors of a building. With the help of an engineer and her special cameras, Maddie show how the gears and weights are controlled by a computer. Next, it's time for lift-off as Maddie heads to a space museum.

videos.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
videos.description: Grace shows off three amazing machines that you have to stand up on. Grace rides an electric surfboard, shows off a jet hoverboard and then goes for a ride through the forest on an off-road personal transporter.

videos.title: Time for School
videos.description: It's Christmas at school, and at carpet time the children have a surprise festive visitor. Mrs Collins helps Jessica, Oliver and Orla make their own hand print reindeer cards, complete with Rudolph's red nose. Later, the children prepare to put on a big Nativity play in front of their parents.

videos.title: Octonauts
videos.description: When an underwater storm destroys a small reef, which a frogfish and other creatures depend on, Tweak and her crewmates must convert the Gup-F into an artificial reef before another storm strikes!

videos.title: Peter Rabbit
videos.description: When Peter is asked to watch Jemima's egg, he discovers that babysitting is far more dangerous than he could ever have imagined.

videos.title: Hey Duggee
videos.description: Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!

videos.title: Piripenguins
videos.description: After a lab mishap, Looph's new 'size-o-matic' machine misfires, causing her to shrink! Now tiny, can she find a clever way to alert her friends and turn everything back to normal?

videos.title: Supertato
videos.description: Evil Pea is tricked by lots of Supertatoes who appear all over the supermarket.

videos.title: Weasy Family
videos.description: Santa didn't visit Weasy, so he has his eyes on the ducklings' presents.

videos.title: Mojo Swoptops
videos.description: The cheese delivery race is on as Mojo and the Racer Top try to deliver food faster than Filo. But the competition gets too hot when an explosive souffle is on the table.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurant with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to. He's going to need an app to order the food.

videos.title: Bluey
videos.description: While Dad and his mates pull out some tree stumps in the garden, Bluey, Bingo and Muffin turn one stump into a nail salon. When it comes time to pull out the girls' stump, Dad must strike a deal.

videos.title: Zog
videos.description: There's an outbreak of firewarts among the little dragons. Zog tries his best to keep Madam Dragon out of harm's way.

videos.title: Balamory
videos.description: It's the Balamory dance away, but Ava is struggling to dance like anyone else. Inspired by the Harbour Master, Ava invents her own moves, which everyone at the nursery soon follows.

videos.title: Waffle's After School Club
videos.description: It's Christmas at After School Club, and everyone helps transform the hall into a magical Winter Waffle Wonderland. All Waffle wants is snow!

videos.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
videos.description: Rafi's wish sends the friends on a real pirate adventure at the swimming pool.

videos.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
videos.description: It's Christmas, and Gran Gran needs a new tree. JoJo and Gran Gran visit the Christmas tree farm and search for the perfect one, not too tall and not too short.

videos.title: Sarah & Duck
videos.description: Flamingo and John get invited around to Sarah and Duck's house, but there is a big obstacle for John.

videos.title: Clangers
videos.description: Major Clanger doesn't hear the other Clangers calling him for soup. Tiny and Small fetch him, but he decides he must invent a new system so that this won't happen again.

videos.title: BeddyByes
videos.description: MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and have fun blowing the seeds. The Yummies help them plant the seeds, and they marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.

videos.title: In the Night Garden
videos.description: Upsy Daisy is singing in the garden when the ball bounces along and comes to a rest beside her. Upsy Daisy can't make up her mind whether to sing or play with the ball.

videos.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
videos.description: Join Romesh Ranganathan as he searches for the mysterious yeti in tonight's bedtime adventure.

videos.title: This Is CBeebies
videos.description: Welcome to the CBeebies channel.
